name: Les Misérables

instructions: Les Misérables was written by Victor Hugo, first published in 1862.
Jean Valjean's journey from convict to redeemed man unfolds against the backdrop of 19th-century France -- an epic examination of justice and mercy.
Discussion prompt: Redemption is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
